title: Finite integer Dirac sums are integer multiplicity 0-currents
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P = Eucl P (any subset), D a finite set (a Finset) with D ⊆ U, and a : ℝ^P → ℤ. Then there is an integer multiplicity current Y ∈ D_0(U) (GeometricCurrentOn U 0 with IsIntegerMultiplicity Y) such that Y(ω) = Σ_{x∈D} a(x)·ω(x)(![]) for every test 0-form ω ∈ D⁰(U) (TestFormOn U 0).
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (D : Finset (Eucl P)) (a : Eucl P → ℤ), (↑D : Set (Eucl P)) ⊆ U → ∃ Y : GeometricCurrentOn U 0, IsIntegerMultiplicity Y ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn U 0, Y ω = ∑ x ∈ D, (a x : ℝ) * (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) 0) x ![]
